title: Singlife One Clark International Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Singlife One Clark International Marathon 2026 Review
meta_description: Singlife One Clark International Marathon 2026 review: 3,500 runners at Clark Parade Grounds on 20 September, a Kenyan 2:24 win and a close Filipino race.
dek: Clark Freeport's international marathon was run from the Clark Parade Grounds on Sunday 20 September 2026. Here is what the race was like, from the reports on it.
verdict: The One Clark International Marathon is a genuinely competitive race. About 3,500 runners took part on 20 September 2026 [2]. Kenyans won both international marathons, Victor Kipkemei Chepkwony in 2:24:28 and Ziporah Wanjiru Kingori in 2:49:20 [1][2], and the Filipino men's race was decided by 16 seconds [2]. There were four distances, from the full marathon down to 5 km, all based at the Clark Parade Grounds [1]. If you want a mid-sized Luzon marathon with a strong field to chase, it is a strong option. The reports describe results, not conditions, so plan your pacing yourself.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 2026 race was run on Sunday 20 September from the Clark Parade Grounds in Pampanga, with Singlife Philippines as title sponsor and SM Supermalls and SM Clark as race-day partners [1][2]. About 3,500 runners took part [2], across the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [1].
The event is supported by the Department of Tourism's Love the Philippines campaign, and a car was raffled among participants on race day [1].

sections.heading: A Fast, Split Field
paragraphs: Results were split into international and Filipino divisions [1][2]. Victor Kipkemei Chepkwony won the international men's marathon in 2:24:28, ahead of Glady Kiptoo (2:26:21) and Eric Chepsiror (2:31:52), and Ziporah Wanjiru Kingori won the women's in 2:49:20 [1][2]. Daniel Boiwo and Pamela Chepkoech Bundotich won the international half marathons in 1:12:46 and 1:27:02 [1][2].

The Filipino marathon was closer. Arbois Jr. won the men's race in 2:32:16, just 16 seconds ahead of Dickyias Mendioro, and Christine Hallasgo won the women's in 3:08:47, 22 seconds ahead of Jessa Mae Roda [2]. Ricky Organiza and Edna Magtubo won the Filipino 21 km, and Jeck Welmer Labrador and Kaye Kayralyn Villanueva the 10 km [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you are chasing a marathon time in Central Luzon, yes. The international field sets a fast pace at the front, and the separate Filipino division means a local podium is decided among local runners.
The reports say nothing about course conditions, heat, water stations or organisation, so if those matter to you, look for runners' accounts before you enter.
This review is compiled from published race reports on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the One Clark International Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: About 3,500 runners took part on Sunday 20 September 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Pampanga, across the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. Results are split into international and Filipino divisions for the longer races.

faqs.question: Who won the 2026 Singlife One Clark International Marathon?
faqs.answer: Kenya's Victor Kipkemei Chepkwony won the men's marathon in 2:24:28 and Ziporah Wanjiru Kingori the women's in 2:49:20. In the Filipino division, Arbois Jr. won the men's race in 2:32:16 and Christine Hallasgo the women's in 3:08:47.

faqs.question: Where does the One Clark International Marathon start and finish?
faqs.answer: At the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, which served as the start, finish and race-day hub for every distance in 2026. Singlife Philippines is the title sponsor.
